description: This public Mendeley dataset contains fifteen experimental runs of a photovoltaic water pump installed at a coffee plantation in Chiang Mai Province, Thailand. The team varied solar irradiance from 300 to 900 watts per square metre, panel tilt from 15 to 35 degrees and panel surface temperature from 30 to 60 degrees Celsius. The repository lists one Raw data.xlsx workbook and describes measured pumping efficiency, processed response-surface data, ANOVA results and regression coefficients. Mendeley states CC BY 4.0. These controlled performance observations may help size a small off-grid irrigation pump, but they are not a full-year solar resource series or a complete hydraulic network. One site, fifteen runs and selected irradiance-temperature combinations are limitations for estimating lifetime yield or water delivery under changing weather. A reviewer-assessed use is checking a pump-efficiency curve in a farm irrigation simulation. model-fao-cropwat is a related crop-water planning model; its crop demand would need separate coupling to this pump evidence. No workbook calculations or field conditions were independently checked.
